paragraphs: Portelier, Ankara'dan bağımsız bir niş parfüm evi. Her formül kendi parfümörümüz tarafından sıfırdan yazılıyor: hazır baz yok, odak grubu yok, komite yok.
Ceren kodlamadan koku kompozisyonuna geçen bir mühendis; Atılay kör testleri ve titizliğiyle bilinen bir güzel sanatçı. Üç ilkeleri var: farklı, baştan çıkarıcı, deneysel.
Her kokudan yalnızca 250 şişe üretiliyor; evde karıştırılıyor, her şişe kişisel kalite kontrolünden geçiyor. Bir koku tükendiğinde bir daha dönmeyebilir.
Portelier is an independent niche perfume house from Ankara. Every formula is written from scratch by our own perfumer: no ready-made bases, no focus groups, no committee.
Ceren is an engineer who moved from code to composition; Atılay is a fine artist known for blind testing and obsessive detail. Three principles: different, seductive, experimental.
Only 250 bottles of each scent are made, mixed in-house, each bottle personally checked. Once a scent is gone, it may never return.

tr: İlk kez deneyecekseniz 10 ml seçenekle ya da dört kokunun 2 ml'lik keşif setiyle başlayın.
Her parti evde küçük miktarda karıştırılıyor ve her şişe tek tek kontrol ediliyor; bir koku tükenince bir daha dönmeyebilir.
Kendi parfümörümüz tarafından sıfırdan; hazır baz kullanılmıyor.
en: Which scent should I start with?
If it's your first time, start with the 10 ml size or the 4 × 2 ml discovery set.
Each batch is mixed in small amounts in-house and every bottle is checked by hand; once a scent is gone, it may never return.
From scratch, by our own perfumer; no ready-made bases.

products.name: Urla
products.description: Sweet meets salt. Warm skin meets cold sea. Ripe fig, a sharp bite of blackcurrant, basil and violet leaf running green and cool, salt in the air — and a warm, skin-close base that stays on you after a swim.

en.name: Urla
en.description: Sweet meets salt. Warm skin meets cold sea. Ripe fig, a sharp bite of blackcurrant, basil and violet leaf running green and cool, salt in the air — and a warm, skin-close base that stays on you after a swim.
composition: Heart: Basil, Sea Water, Violet Leaf
Üst: İncir, Guatemala Kakulesi, Frenk Üzümü
Kalp: Fesleğen, Deniz Suyu, Menekşe Yaprağı
Dip: Deniz Odunu, Sandal Ağacı, Amber Gri

products.name: Manche
products.description: Bergamot opens bright and citrus-sharp, but this sea was never going to stay clean. Cucumber and galbanum bring a cold, green snap, sage cuts in bitter, and seaweed drags it all back to the water: salt, brine, something alive. Amber and sandalwood keep it close to warm skin.

en.name: Manche

composition: Dip: Deniz Yosunu, Amber, Sandal Ağacı

products.name: Nesso
products.description: Ginger and Italian orange fizz up like the first pour, champagne sparkling over the top. Then the flowers arrive: magnolia, jasmine and tuberose, lush and a little heady. Honey thickens it all into something sweet and sticky, while cedarwood and patchouli keep it warm and grounded.

en.name: Nesso
en.description: Ginger and Italian orange fizz up like the first pour, champagne sparkling over the top. Then the flowers arrive: magnolia, jasmine and tuberose, lush and a little heady. Honey thickens it all into something sweet and sticky, while cedarwood and patchouli keep it warm and grounded.

products.name: Ribeira
products.description: Clove, saffron and thyme open warm and spicy, nothing like the vanilla you were expecting. Leather and heliotrope add a smooth, almost powdery depth at the heart. Then bourbon vanilla and incense take over: rich, dark and smoky, vanilla pushed as far from simple as it goes.
